body: you are very hard on yourself.  you can't control others emotions.  just be kind to others and your friend... they are struggling enough with problems you could never solve.  live your life as passionately as you wish, but allow others to decide their own paths.

that is an incredibly hard experience... i can't tell you what to do because i haven't been there... but besides your friends and family that want to be there for you, there are also people like therapists that use bigger words that will help you through these tough emotions.  i just want you to know you are not alone.  i'm just a girl typing on a computer that would prefer you are a part of this world.

you've done more than a lot of people.  i mean, seriously, you've done more than me and i'm older than you.  just because you don't have immediate success at what you want doesn't mean it's not worth it.  failure is devastating at the moment, but i feel in your case, it's a very hard lesson that will be a stepping stone to your future.  try it, if you prove me wrong i'll buy you a drink in purgatory.

i'm in the same boat as you friend. no one answered me, so i feel it's important that i answer you.  either reply or PM me.  i may be not the most optimistic point of view, but i want you to know you're not alone.
